abilities.name: Dryad's Swiftness
abilities.description: Lunara moves 20% faster by leaping short distances.

fields.notes: Lunara cannot Mount. Dryad's Swiftness grants Lunara +90% Movement Speed that gradually decays to -50% in a repeating cycle of 10 game ticks: +90% > +75% > +60% > +45% > +30% > +15% > +0% > +0% > -50% > -50% (1 tick = 0.0625 seconds), resulting in an average Movement Speed increase of +21.5%. The 50% ticks are set as a Movement Speed maximum and cannot be exceeded using any Movement Speed buffs. Issuing a 'stop' command resets Dryad's Swiftness ' Movement Speed cycle and can, with repetition, be used to reach higher average Movement Speed than intended.
